label: No placebo
rationale: This is an open pilot with a single intervention group, so there is no control arm or placebo comparator described. All dyads receive the RT-ALS skills-based sessions, followed by pre-post assessments and an exit interview.

evidence.quote: Dyads will participate in 6 30-45-minute skills based sessions.
